title: File:Malala and Freida Pinto meet the Youth For Change panel cropped frida.jpg
art: DFID - UK Department for International Development
desc:
"Let's educate the girl and make her independent, she can become whatever she wants to," inspiring words from Malala at the Girl Summit.
She's seen here with actress and Plan International Girls' Rights Ambassador, Freida Pinto, discussing girls' rights with the Youth For Change panel.

Picture: Jes
